class.name: RealityVolumeWindowOptions
class.brief_description: Physical size and presentation preferences for a volume.
class.description: All dimensions are in meters; zero on an axis leaves that preference to the system. Options are snapshots: apply changes with [method RealitySceneTree.set_volume_window_options]. Requested dimensions are preferences, while [method RealitySceneTree.get_volume_window_size] reports the measured result. The system can constrain sizing. These options do not control window placement.

members.member: Preferred size for the next open, clamped to configured limits. Does not resize an existing host.
Minimum extent. Each nonzero component must not exceed its corresponding nonzero maximum.
Maximum extent; zero leaves the axis unconstrained by the application.
System default, fixed current size, or user resizing. Initial preferences are used when no actual size exists.
System baseplate visibility. Does not affect the rendered Godot scene.
